scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build ./src/index.html --outdir=dist --sourcemap --target=browser --minify --define:process.env.NODE_ENV='"production"' --env='BUN_PUBLIC_*' && bun run postbuild
scripts.postbuild: bun -e "import { cpSync, mkdirSync } from 'fs'; try { cpSync('public', 'dist', { recursive: true }); } catch(e) {}"
